Forged using ancient technology it just may be among the sharpest conventional weapons ever made.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 15 |durability = 26 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Eightfold Blade}} Eightfold Blades are kodachi forged with [[Sheikah]] [[Ancient Technology]], thought to be among the sharpest [[Weapon]]s ever made. These swords belong to the [[Sheikah Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons created by the Sheikah.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 170}} They can be found in [[West Necluda]] and around [[Lake Hylia]], particularly near the Sheikah town of [[Kakariko Village]]. They can also be found in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn after scanning the {{SSB}} Series [[Sheik]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Since Eightfold Blades are made of metal, they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune on the [[Sheikah Slate]]. They also attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]], and they conduct [[Electricity]].
